warning.text:
[TODO:ja] "He will take your sons and fields."
The people still cry for one.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] His words are for you too.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Quiet Your Voice
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Listen before you answer.
The prophet speaks for God.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You let his words sink deep.

walk_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Stay and Hear
walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] These words will shape your life.
Return and listen.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You step back to the circle.

lost_path.title: [TODO:ja] Father's Donkeys Are Lost
lost_path.text:
[TODO:ja] Days of searching, hills of dust.
A servant says, "There is a seer here."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Pay him only for the donkeys

giveup_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Press Onward
giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Your search is more than donkeys.
Go to the seer.

pay_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Greater Than Coin
pay_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] He has no need of your silver.
Go and hear his word.

anointing.title: [TODO:ja] Oil on Your Head
anointing.text:
[TODO:ja] Samuel pours oil and kisses you.
"The Lord has chosen you to lead."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] A king kneels before God first.
[TODO:ja] Do not refuse what God gives.
[TODO:ja] The oil runs warm down your brow.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Bow First
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] The crown is heavy with calling.
Receive it in humility.

reject_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Do Not Refuse
reject_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] God Himself anoints through Samuel.
Receive what is given.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Your hands rest open at your side.

assembly.title: [TODO:ja] Tribes Gather at Mizpah
assembly.text:
[TODO:ja] Lots fall and your name is called.
The people search the camp.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] God will still bring you out.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Serve First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] A king of Israel serves the Lord.
Step forward humbly.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Found Among the Jars
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] They draw you out into the light.
Your calling cannot be hidden.

confirmation.title: [TODO:ja] "Long Live the King!"
confirmation.text:
[TODO:ja] The tribes shout and bow before you.
A new road opens at your feet.
